answer: Each identity carries vote weight on a jade ledger. The marble tally counts only weight refreshed this epoch: weight decays 10% per epoch, and only a 5-credit top-up from that identity's stake restores it. One top-up refreshes one identity only, so the kth fake needs its own 50-credit base stake plus 5 credits per epoch; 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and bleed 5,000 per epoch, 100,000 over ten epochs. A whisper transfer moving refreshed weight between identities is rejected, as weight binds to its key. An honest agent keeps one weight with one 5-credit top-up per epoch.
